analyst_view.overall: Early view: Benfica top the league phase on goal difference after a 3-1 home win over Lech Poznan, their fourth win from four. OFI Crete are 16th after a 2-0 win over Hapoel Be'er Sheva and could still finish in the play-off places, which gives them a reason to defend carefully in Lisbon.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. Benfica scored three against Lech from 24 shots, while OFI kept a clean sheet against Be'er Sheva, so the site's figure is a fair middle.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.1 corners. I lean slightly lower: Benfica created a lot against Lech but won only six corners, and OFI took two in their last game, so the total may not climb as high as the site expects.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. Benfica's game with Lech had three yellows and OFI's had four, both close to the site's number; the referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.9 shots. Benfica's 24 shots against Lech and OFI's 11 at Be'er Sheva support a high total, so I stay with the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.1 shots on target. Benfica put 12 on target against Lech on their own, which backs the site's figure.
